description: Hi, we are a group of friends looking to have a fun experience with this Hackathon.
summary: Our project is a game where you play as an alien who has crashed on Earth while trying to go to the Moon, and is now trying to fix its 'space mobility hovercraft' to verify if the Moon is actually made of cheese. The goal of the game is to be fun, and we decided to get really creative so that even people who don't have a science background could find enjoyment in this game! We believe that to be super important, as the more enjoyable and humorous a game is, the more real science and harder topics we can add to it without losing player retention.
details: Our project is a creative take on the space mission prompt given to us! We wanted to have the player be an alien finding his way to the Moon using a point-and-click type of playstyle. We used an open-source program called Adventure Game Studio to create our project, which used its own code language based on C, C++, and Java. The goal of the game is to be a bit silly by having the player suspend their disbelief to have fun, but also to include real scientific data. Unfortunately, we were unable to finish the game, but our team found the process to be very fun!
